name: qa-serverless
description: Serverless testing for AWS Lambda, Azure Functions and Cloudflare Workers: local emulators, cold-start and timeout budgets, and integration test suites. Builds integration tests from SAM, Serverless Framework, Wrangler, Vercel or Netlify definitions and covers .NET Lambda test tools. A critic agent (serverless-cold-start-critic) flags cold-start anti-patterns.
